description: Send Web Push notifications from a Go backend using webpush-go (VAPID authentication, payload encryption, subscription storage, and browser subscribe flow). Use when working with Push API subscriptions in Go, Web Push Protocol, VAPID key management, browser push notifications, or migrating a Node web-push implementation to Go. Covers VAPID key generation, encrypting payloads, the aes128gcm encoding, subscription persistence in Postgres, and the browser-side subscribe code.
